Input image 1 (Anassa) and input image 2 (Illustris) are ONLY artistic style references, not identity or costume targets. Subject: Kyreon, an imposing adult MALE forest deity and god-king, shown as a magnificent regal SATYR with an elf-like upper body. Clearly pointed ELF EARS protrude on both sides of his head: this is an explicit character-specific exception to the rounded-ear humans elsewhere. A human-shaped face completely covered by one elegant dual-metal ceremonial mask, divided vertically into SILVER on one half and GOLD on the other, with simple eye slits. Below the tunic show TWO separate brown furry goat-like satyr legs ending in TWO cloven HOOVES, both fully visible. Do not give him human legs, human feet or a deer body.

One hand firmly holds one impressive great ceremonial SPEAR, with a broad straight silver leaf-shaped spearhead, gold collar and a single straight wooden shaft. Show the entire spear from sharp tip to butt fully within the frame; it stands beside his body and does not pass through him. Other hand open in a modest sovereign gesture. No extra people, animals or props.

One leg on each side, readable silhouette, no cropping. Genuine transparent alpha background including gaps between antlers, arm and spear. NO background, scene, rectangle, paper, floor, shadows, glow, haze, text, letters, labels, watermark, photorealism, CGI or toy rendering.
